content: Naataane Baggara Xoossi Dawites Yootida Qaala
Dawiti ba kawoteththa keeththan de7ishe, nabe Naataanes, «Tani zigappe keexettida keeththan de7ays; gido attiin Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay gidikko dunkaane giddon dees» gides.
Naataaney qasse Dawites, «Ooththanaas ne wozinan ne qoppidayssa ubbaa ooththa; Xoossi nenara dees» gides.
Gido attiin he gallassa omars Xoossa qaalay Naataanekko yiidi,
«Ba; baada ta aylle Dawites GODAY nees gizayssi ta izan de7ana keeth keexxanay nena gidakka.
Tani Isra7eeleta Gibxeppe kessida gallassaafe doommada hach gakkanaas, dunkaanaappe dunkaanen, qasse issi sohoppe hara soho yuuyada de7ays attiin keeththan de7abeekke.
Tani Isra7eele asaa ubbaara yuuyida soho ubbaan ta deraa heemmanaas tani azazida Isra7eele daannatappe oonaska, ‹Taas ziga miththafe keeth ays keexxibeeketii?› gaada oychchida wodey dizee?
«Hessa gishshas ha7ikka neni ta aylle Dawites, Ubbaafe Wolqqama Xoossi nena, ‹Ta deraa Isra7eele ayssana mala neni dorsa heemmizasohoppe ta nena denththa ekkadis.
Neni bida soho ubbaan tani nenara issife gidadis; ne morkketa ubbaa ne sinththafe diggadis; ha7ikka tani ha sa7an erettida gita asata sunththaa mala ne sunththaa gitasana.
Tani ta asaa Isra7eeles daanasoho immana; isttas duussasoho immidaappe guye istti qaaxxontta mala ta ooththana; iita asati kase istta un7eththidayssaththo hayssafe guye istta un7eththettenna.

Hayssafe kase ta deraa Isra7eele kaaleththizayta ta sunththida wode kase iitati un7eththidayssaththo hayssafe guye un7eththettenna; intte morkketa ubbaa ta kawushshana; tani Xoossay nees keeth keexxanayssa yootays.
Ne cimmada kase hayqqida ne aawatan gayttiza wode tani ne naytappe issaa denththada ne sohon kawoththana; iza kawoteththaaka ta minththana.
Taas keeth keexxanay iza; tani iza kawoteththa araataa mernaas minththa essana.
Tani izas aawa gidana; izikka taas naa gidana; neeppe kase kawotida Sa7ooleppe tani ta maaroteththaa denththida mala izappe mulekka denththike.
Tani iza ta asaa bollanne ta kawoteththaa bolla mernaas sunththana; iza kawoteththa araataykka mernaas minni eqqana› gaada yoota» gides.
Naataaney Xoossay izas ajjuutan qonccisida qaala ubbaa Dawites yootides.
Dawite Woosa
Hessafe guye Kawo Dawiti dunkaanen gelidi GODAA sinththan uttides; histtidi, «Abeet GODAWU, Xoossawu! Neni hayssa ubbaa taas ooththanaas tani oonee? Taso asaykka aazee?
Abeet Xoossawu! Hayssi ne ayfe sinththan guuththa misatiin ne aylle zareti sinththafe yaana layththatan hananayssa yootadasa; neni tana gita asatappe dhoqqu histta xeelladasa.
Neni tana ne aylleza bonchchida gishshas tani Dawiti hayssafe bollara ay gaana dandayazinaa? Neni tana ne aylleza eraasa.
Abeet GODAWU! Ne aylleza gishshas ne wozina qofaa mala ha gita miishshata ubbaa ooththada ha gitateththaa ubbaa tana erisadasa.
«Abeet GODAWU! Ne malay haray baawa; nuni nu hayththan siyida mala neeppe attiin hara Xoossi deenna.

Neni Xoossi Gibxe biittafe kessida ne deraa sinththafe kawoteththata gooddada gitanne yashissiza miish ne sunththas ooththana mala, deraakka nees wozzana mala ne isttas ooththidayssaththo ne dere Isra7eele mala derey biitta bolla haray dizee?
Neni ne deraa Isra7eele mernaas nees histtadasa; abeet GODAWU nenikka istta Xoossa gidadasa.
«Abeet GODAWU! Neni ne ayllezasinne iza zereththatas immida hidotaa mernaas minththa; neni immida hidota qaalaakka pola.

Hessa ne ooththanay ne sunththi minni daana malanne mernaas gita gidana malassa; hessafe guye asay, ‹Ubbaafe Wolqqama Xoossay tumukka Isra7eele Xoossa› gaana gees; ne aylle Dawite zareti ne sinththan minni eqqana.
«Abeet ta Xoossawu, ‹Neni taas ne ayllezas keeth keexxana ga yootadasa; hessa gishshas tani ne aylley nena woossanaas xaladis.
Abeet GODAWU! Neni tumu Xoossa; ha lo7o hidota qaala ne ayllezas immadasa.
Ne sinththan mernaas daana mala ne aylleza keeth anjjanaas ne koyadasa; Abeet GODAWU! Neni anjjiday mernaas anjjettidaade gidana› gi woossees» gides.
